  • Em situações de furo de estoque, acompanha atentamente a gestão do setor, envolvendo a consideração de oferecer produtos similares ou a confirmação da ruptura, visando assegurar que a expedição seja realizada na data de entrega acordada;
  • Garante o fluxo da demanda de retirada imediata do dia, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a produtividade e a qualidade. Também monitora os pedidos com prazos de retirada expirados, tomando as ações necessárias, como o contato com o cliente ou o cancelamento do pedido;
  • Mantém uma interação diária com a torre de controle e também reuniões mensais, avaliando as ocorrências e prestando suporte à equipe de administração logística, com acompanhamento atento do gestor;
  • Exerce supervisão sobre a equipe ADM, garantindo que todas as entregas programadas para o dia tenham Documento de Transporte (DT). Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;
  • Utiliza o painel de roteirização para extrair informações relevantes que embasam suas decisões, antecipando-se a possíveis problemas apontados em ressalvas feitas pelos clientes e agilizando as soluções;
  • Busca constantemente maior agilidade e eficiência na resolução de casos de furo de estoque, aplicando análises cuidadosas e tomando decisões assertivas com relativa autonomia;
  • Identifica os gargalos operacionais e organiza a equipe de acordo com os picos de maior fluxo, assegurando que o tempo de separação dos pedidos e a permanência do cliente no local estejam alinhados com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Demonstra habilidade na análise de relatórios, propondo ações destinadas a aprimorar os processos existentes e alcançar os resultados almejados;
  • Contribui com o Gerente de Operações Logísticas, selecionando, contratando, animando, desenvolvendo e retendo conforme avaliação e necessidades do setor;
  • Atua na busca contínua por oportunidades de melhoria, antecipa-se a problemas, contribuindo com soluções adequadas;

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 7,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Loan Partner II delivers exceptional customer service from contract to closing by guiding borrowers through each step of the loan process. This role oversees the end-to-end loan pipeline, including interest rate locks, to ensure timely and compliant closings. By providing consistent updates on key milestones, next steps, and action items, this role keeps borrowers and real estate partners well-informed. The Loan Partner II drives high customer satisfaction and fosters lasting client relationships through proactive communication and engagement.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-quality customer service throughout the loan process, from contract execution to closing.
  • Contact the borrower within 24 hours of file receipt to introduce the role, set expectations, outline next steps, and review the Uniform Residential Loan Application (Form 1003) for completeness and accuracy.
  • Send introductory emails to both the buyer’s and seller’s agents for new purchase contracts, copying the Loan Officer.
  • Create and distribute personalized introductory and appreciation videos to enhance client engagement.
  • Distribute, review, and explain (via phone call) the Closing Disclosures (CDs) to borrowers, addressing questions and correcting errors before sending the documents out for signature.
  • Notify Realtors and builders to coordinate closing, providing client support as needed.
  • Draft and distribute closing notifications to all parties, detailing the date, time, location, required documents, cash-to-close amounts, and remittance instructions.
  • Notify the Marketing team of the closing date, time, and location to ensure on-site closing gift delivery.
  • Maintain a minimum 95% five-star rating on post-closing client satisfaction surveys.
  • Manage a pipeline of loans to ensure smooth and on-time closings; participate in daily and weekly pipeline review meetings to track loan status and address processing bottlenecks.
  • Stay current on loan products and regulatory requirements to ensure accurate and compliant processing.
  • Review loan files to identify and notate any items needed from the borrower within 24 hours prior to submission.
  • Collaborate with the Operations Manager to troubleshoot and resolve processing challenges.
  • Communicate underwriting conditions to borrowers within 48 hours of receipt, providing both verbal explanations and written condition lists.
  • Perform a quality control review of final loan paperwork against established checklists and compliance standards.
  • Submit loans to Underwriting at least 15 days before the scheduled closing.
  • Deliver closing documents to Closing within 72 hours (3 business days) prior to the closing date.
  • Distribute weekly lender status updates (LSUs) to Realtors, Loan Officers, and Operations Managers.
  • Notify borrowers of key milestones such as appraisal completion, underwriting approval, and document delivery to the title company and provide weekly status updates through scheduled phone calls and follow-up emails, summarizing progress, soliciting feedback, and requesting referrals.
  • Conduct post-closing follow-up via phone call and email to congratulate, thank, and gather feedback from the borrower.
  • Generate at least one client referral per transaction through proactive relationship management and service excellence.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • State and Federal NMLS License, preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in conventional fixed-rate and ARM, HELOC, and construction mortgage loan processing or origination.
  • Experience with mortgage loan processing.
  • Experience with Encompass.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in DU, LP, Microsoft Office, and Windows.

title: Principal Architect
description:
Overview

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client’s business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.
  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.
  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.
  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.
  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.
  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and broaden sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.
  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.
  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies).
  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.
  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.
  • Architectural Knowledge:
    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.
    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.
    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.
  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.
  • Drive and Problem Solving:
    • "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.
    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.
  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.
  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!
description:
KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!

Dit jaar starten we alweer aan het zevende bestuursjaar van onze stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig. Na de successen van voorgaande jaren in India, Malawi, Zambia en Sri Lanka, gaat KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig dit jaar vol voor stichting Estrela De Fuvela in Rio de Janeiro! Daarom gaan 30 KnappeKoppen dit jaar allemaal in hun eigen stad veel geld inzamelen zodat zij een uitbreiding van een klaslokaal van Estrela de Favela kunnen realiseren!

Lana, Wat is KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig eigenlijk?
KnappeKoppen is ooit ontstaan vanuit een initiatief van studenten uit Amsterdam en Utrecht. Zij wilden graag iets terug doen voor hun stad en anderen. Uit deze mooie visie ontstond Stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig, onderdeel van het commerciële bedrijf KnappeKoppen. Vier studenten vormden in 2018 samen het eerste stichtingsbestuur. Zij begonnen in hun eigen steden met lokale acties, zoals helpen bij de Voedselbank, ouderen een mooie dag bezorgen of kerstpakketten uitdelen. Later realiseerden ze zich dat ze impact wilden maken buiten hun eigen stadsmuren. Sindsdien zet het bestuur van de stichting zich ieder jaar in voor zowel hun eigen stad als voor een mooi (jaarlijks gekozen) internationaal doel.

Niek, waar denk jij dat in Rotterdam op dit moment de meeste behoefte is aan vrijwilligers?
Ik denk dat er in Rotterdam al veel mooie initiatieven zijn die zich inzetten voor de maatschappij. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan Stichting Betrokken Student en Oma’s Soep: twee mooie voorbeelden van organisaties die werken aan verbinding tussen de inwoners van Rotterdam. Toch is er op veel gebieden nog steeds een grote behoefte aan vrijwilligers.

Wij, als KnappeKoppen Rotterdam, zouden bijvoorbeeld maaltijdpakketten kunnen maken voor deze gezinnen of meehelpen bij een van de vele locaties van de Voedselbank. Daarnaast kunnen we soep rondbrengen naar eenzame ouderen en samen met hen een kop koffie drinken.

Sanna, kun je ons meenemen in de plannen voor komend jaar? Wat gaan jullie doen en waar ligt de focus op?
We hebben superveel leuke plannen voor het komende jaar! Een deel daarvan sluit aan bij de tijd van het jaar: zo denken we aan een Valentijnsactie, wijnflessen of kerstbomen verkopen rond de feestdagen en natuurlijk hutspotpakketten tijdens Leidens Ontzet.

Sterre, jullie hebben dit jaar gekozen voor stichting Estrela de Favela. Kun je iets meer vertellen over dit goede doel en waarom juist deze keuze is gemaakt?
Estrela de Favela is een stichting die zich inzet voor kansarme kinderen in de Braziliaanse favela’s. Zij bieden onderwijs aan kinderen van 5 tot 17 jaar, waarbij niet alleen aandacht wordt besteed aan de reguliere schoolvakken, maar ook aan ‘life skills’ en sociale vaardigheden.

Joep, wat is er allemaal nodig om het project te realiseren in Brazilië, en hoe kunnen mensen bijdragen of doneren?
Zoals Sterre vertelde, zetten wij ons dit jaar in om een nieuw klaslokaal mogelijk te maken voor kinderen in de favela! Het ingezamelde geld gaat naar de bouw en inrichting van deze plek, zodat kinderen een veilige omgeving krijgen om te leren, spelen en zich te ontwikkelen.

Keet, wat hopen jij en je bestuur dit jaar te bereiken, en hoe gaan jullie dat als team aanpakken?
Dit jaar willen wij in Groningen laten zien dat je naast je studie ook echt impact kunt maken, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Ons doel is om zoveel mogelijk studenten te betrekken bij onze acties, want hoe meer mensen meedoen, hoe groter het verschil.

Tot slot, Naomi! Hoe ga jij al deze besturen bijstaan dit studiejaar?
Dit jaar heb ik de eer om al deze fantastische KnappeKoppen te begeleiden als manager en te ondersteunen met zowel de lokale acties als natuurlijk het grote project in Rio de Janeiro voor Estrela de Favela waar Sterre jullie al meer over heeft verteld!

title: Senior Product Manager, Social Marketplaces & Live Shopping
description:
Senior Product Manager, Social Marketplaces & Live Shopping

ABOUT THE ROLE

VTEX is the backbone of connected commerce. This is why we believe in the power of shopping driven by network effect & influence. Our integrations with Google, Meta, and TikTok Ads , combined with our Live Shopping product, are at the core of this vision. We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Senior Product Manager to lead the product strategy for Social Marketplaces & Live Shopping, shaping how commerce happens at the intersection of content, community, and conversion.

This role will be pivotal in defining global target markets, understanding customer needs, and unlocking opportunities for platform evolution that strengthen our value proposition. You’ll work cross-functionally with our core commerce technology teams and external partners, driving execution of the strategy and expanding the products worldwide.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • PM of two squads: one managing integrations with Google, Meta, and TikTok, and the other focused on the Live Shopping add-on.
  • Define and evolve product strategy, aligning roadmaps with business priorities and customer impact.
  • Identify and analyze global target markets and customer profiles, uncovering growth opportunities.
  • Negotiate and collaborate with both internal teams and external partners to ensure successful execution.
  • Shape adoption and retention strategies across regions, being directly involved in GTM strategy.
  • Drive cross-team alignment: ensure Social Marketplaces and Live Shopping scale efficiently by leveraging VTEX’s commerce core.
  • Increase transparency and engagement around the product roadmap with customers, through initiatives like roadmap artifacts, webinars with Tier 1 customers, and presentations to leadership.
  • Spot high ROI opportunities, leading research and analysis to validate and prioritize them.
  • Be an active voice in the Product Management chapter, helping raise the bar for product excellence at VTEX.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Strong background in product strategy and product management within retail, e-commerce, or tech environments.
  • Skilled at building alignment, negotiating, and managing relationships across multiple levels and teams.
  • Comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative analysis to drive business outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to craft clear narratives and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Fluent in English and at least intermediate level of Spanish for daily collaboration.
  • Curious about consumer behavior, passionate about how integrations, social platforms, and network effects can drive GMV growth and reshape shopping experiences.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

Founded in 2000, VTEX has a history of growth and a global presence with more than 1,300 employees across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia.

For more information, visit

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

BENEFITS

  • Annual profit-sharing program and equity eligibility;
  • Health, dental, and life insurance with national coverage provided by VTEX;
  • Flexible meal allowance;
  • Extended parental leaves;
  • Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture;
  • Financial assistance to build your work-from-home setup;
  • Wellness program;
  • Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Abbott Heart Failure (HF) delivers devices for patients living with heart failure in the areas of hemodynamic monitoring and mechanical circulatory support. Medical affairs of Abbott HF is seeking to hire a director who will join a team of medical specialists dedicated to all medical aspects of safe and effective device heart failure treatment. The director will report to the Chief Medical Officer.

The Director of Medical Affairs will provide daily business operations support related to product development and clinical research, product quality, compliance, commercial/marketing activities and customer interactions. The director assists the Chief Medical Officer in being medical representative of Abbott HF to external regulatory agencies and professional societies.

Responsibilities

  • The Medical Director
  • Develops medical opinions, medical platform documents and Health Hazard Assessments.
  • Provides medical input for promotional and commercial activities as requested.
  • Serves as medical representative on Risk Evaluation teams.
  • Assists investigation teams by providing medical input as needed.
  • Responsible for updating medical affairs procedural documents and submitting change requests when needed.
  • Provides medical support for MDR reporting when needed.
  • Provides initial medical input for quality/regulatory customer communications, technical bulletins and quality directives.
  • Engages with direct customer interactions with medical content as needed.
  • Regionally responsible for Investigator Initiated Study and Research Grant programs
  • Provides input or content to professional education activities
  • Responsible for engaging in and documenting off-label discussions
  • Assists the chief medical officer in KOL and professional society engagement
  • Provides medical input to new product development

Qualifications

An MD is strongly preferred for this role, but a PhD in a relevant area would be considered. A minimum of 5 years of clinical experience including in CV medicine would be required. A minimum of 1-2 industry experience would be preferred. Significant experience with clinical research, including interpretation and presentation would be expected. Strong presentation skills required.

The role is remote. Up to 70 % travel should be expected.

description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

  • Familiaridade com design patterns;
  • Boas práticas de escrita de código limpo;
  • Capacidade de estruturar projetos escaláveis;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, boa comunicação e que valorize o compartilhamento de conhecimento;
  • Tenha proatividade e seja protagonista da sua carreira.

title: Agente De Viagens Com Português Avançado + Amadeus
description:
Sobre a Boostomer

A Boostomer é uma Agência de Experiência do Cliente com sede em Barcelona, que oferece serviços de consultoria e terceirização para empresas emergentes e em expansão.

Descrição

Um dos nossos clientes é uma empresa especializada em serviços de atendimento ao cliente para agências de viagens, operando na Espanha e em Portugal. Nossa equipe atua no suporte a viajantes corporativos fora do horário comercial, garantindo um atendimento de alta qualidade em momentos críticos.

O que estamos buscando?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Agente de Viagens com experiência em reservas e suporte a clientes corporativos, com disponibilidade para atuar em turnos noturnos e nos fins de semana. Se você é organizado(a), autônomo(a) e com habilidades em resolução de problemas, queremos te conhecer!

Você é a pessoa ideal se:

  • Fala português em nível avançado (não consideramos nível intermediário).
  • Tem experiência avançada comprovada com o sistema Amadeus.
  • É autônomo(a), resolutivo(a) e capaz de lidar com emergências.
  • Tem experiência em gestão de reservas, alterações e suporte a viajantes corporativos.

Responsabilidades

  • Oferecer suporte a viajantes corporativos em situações de emergência.
  • Gerenciar reservas e alterações usando sistemas como Amadeus.
  • Resolver incidentes de forma eficiente, garantindo uma experiência fluida ao cliente.

Horário e disponibilidade

Todos os turnos serão informados com pelo menos 1 mês de antecedência. Horários abaixo expressos em hora da Argentina.

  • De segunda a sexta-feira: das 02h às 04h (madrugada)
  • Fins de semana: 10 horas divididas entre sábado e domingo, ou concentradas em um único dia. Faixa de horário: das 03h às 19h.
  • Excepcionalmente, pode haver necessidade de um turno vespertino das 13h às 19h.

Exemplos de horários:

  • Sábado das 14h às 19h e domingo das 14h às 19h
  • Das 09h às 19h ou das 03h às 13h

Observação : a partir de março/april, haverá mudança de horário na Espanha (adiantamento de 1 hora).

Benefícios

  • Pagamento por hora em USD, conforme sua experiência e habilidades
  • Participação em um projeto com grande projeção e crescimento
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo
  • Treinamento 100% pago
  • Modalidade 100% remota

Previsão de início : Julho de 2025

Requisitos técnicos

  • Computador: processador Core i5 (7ª geração ou superior), ou equivalente, com no mínimo 8 GB de RAM
  • Armazenamento: mínimo de 256 GB SSD ou 500 GB HDD
  • Internet: velocidade mínima de 25 Mbps (upload e download)
  • Sistema operacional: Windows original
  • Áudio: fones de ouvido com cancelamento de ruído
  • Vídeo: notebook/PC com webcam ou câmera de boa qualidade

We invite a skilled and proactive Intermediate Project Manager with Scrum Master experience to join our team. We actively recruit in Brazil, Argentina or Colombia, offering a comfortable remote environment. Submit your CV in English, and we'll get back to you!

  • Advance your PM and leadership skills in a dynamic Agile environment
  • Join a collaborative community of Project Managers and share knowledge and best practices
  • Work with international teams across Europe and Latin America and gain cross-cultural experience

Is that you?

  • 3 years of experience as a Project Manager
  • Solid understanding of Agile practices (Scrum) and experience facilitating ceremonies
  • Proficiency in project management theory, key tools, and frameworks
  • Strong skills in planning, execution, delivery, and risk management
  • Proven ability to manage schedules, budgets, and change requests
  • Upper-Intermediate+ English level with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams, and clients

  • Drive Agile projects using and/or SAFe to ensure successful delivery

  • Identify and mitigate project risks and blockers proactively

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, QA, data engineers, architects, and other PMs

Dev.Pro is a global company that's been building great software since 2011. Our team values fairness, high standards, openness, and inclusivity for everyone — no matter your background.

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting.   • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance

You’ll be responsible for providing top-tier support to our global user base and ensuring smooth daily operations across hardware, software, network, and collaboration tools.   • Drive IT automation initiatives using scripting tools or low-code / no-code platforms to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
  • Act as a customer experience champion, ensuring responsive, high-quality support for all employees, regardless of their location.

  • Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, security settings, integrations, and advanced troubleshooting.
  • Oversee the end-to-end IT asset lifecycle for a remote workforce, including procurement, zero-touch deployment, tracking, and secure decommissioning.
  • Support and optimize collaboration tools like Slack, Jira Service Management, Zoom, Confluence, and Google Meet.
  • Standardize and document IT processes, creating robust knowledge bases and support procedures for a remote-first environment.
  • Lead remote onboarding and offboarding operations, coordinating closely with Compliance, People, and Security teams.
  • Contribute to IT compliance efforts (SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) within a cloud-native infrastructure.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of IT Experience, ideally with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role supporting a remote or hybrid workforce. English is a MUST have.
  • Proven experience providing exceptional IT support to a globally distributed, remote workforce.
  • Experience supporting Mac, Linux, and Windows platforms in a corporate environment.
  • Strong expertise in networking principles (TCP / IP, DNS, VPN)
  • Demonstrated success in driving IT automation or process improvements with measurable outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience managing a distributed IT asset lifecycle using modern asset management tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace administration and automation.
  • Solid experience with Workspace ONE UEM or other modern MDM / UEM solutions (e.g., Jamf, Kandji, Intune).
  • Exceptional documentation, project management, and cross-team collaboration skills, essential for a remote-first environment.
  • Prior experience in a startup, fast-paced, or agile environment is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC2, PCI, ISO 27001.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Passion for leveraging AI tools in IT operations or familiarity with emerging AI-enhanced IT solutions.

title: Executivo De Vendas

Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ.

Requisitos mínimos

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e / ou carteira de clientes ativa.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

  • Continually reviews drilling operations performance, identifying and sharing lessons learned and leading continuous improvement in performance and process optimisation.
  • Proactively identifies and shares global and local takeaways through close collaborative relationships with key internal partners and develops themes/trends from issues and incidents.

Development & Training

  • Provide support and coaching as needed to ensure the safe and efficient planning/execution of activities.

title: Netsuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location : Remote – Brazil

Salary : USD 1,700 / month

Schedule : 40 hours / week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

Sobre a Boostomer

A Boostomer é uma Agência de Experiência do Cliente com sede em Barcelona, que oferece serviços de consultoria e terceirização para empresas emergentes e em expansão.

Descrição

Um dos nossos clientes é uma empresa especializada em serviços de atendimento ao cliente para agências de viagens, operando na Espanha e em Portugal. Nossa equipe atua no suporte a viajantes corporativos fora do horário comercial, garantindo um atendimento de alta qualidade em momentos críticos.

O que estamos buscando?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Agente de Viagens com experiência em reservas e suporte a clientes corporativos, com disponibilidade para atuar em turnos noturnos e nos fins de semana. Se você é organizado(a), autônomo(a) e com habilidades em resolução de problemas, queremos te conhecer!

Você é a pessoa ideal se:

  • Fala português em nível avançado (não consideramos nível intermediário).
  • Tem experiência avançada comprovada com o sistema Amadeus.
  • É autônomo(a), resolutivo(a) e capaz de lidar com emergências.
  • Tem experiência em gestão de reservas, alterações e suporte a viajantes corporativos.

Responsabilidades

  • Oferecer suporte a viajantes corporativos em situações de emergência.
  • Gerenciar reservas e alterações usando sistemas como Amadeus.
  • Resolver incidentes de forma eficiente, garantindo uma experiência fluida ao cliente.

Horário e disponibilidade

Todos os turnos serão informados com pelo menos 1 mês de antecedência. Horários abaixo expressos em hora da Argentina.

  • De segunda a sexta-feira: das 02h às 04h (madrugada)
  • Fins de semana: 10 horas divididas entre sábado e domingo, ou concentradas em um único dia. Faixa de horário: das 03h às 19h.
  • Excepcionalmente, pode haver necessidade de um turno vespertino das 13h às 19h.

Exemplos de horários:

  • Sábado das 14h às 19h e domingo das 14h às 19h
  • Das 09h às 19h ou das 03h às 13h

Observação : a partir de março/april, haverá mudança de horário na Espanha (adiantamento de 1 hora).

Benefícios

  • Pagamento por hora em USD, conforme sua experiência e habilidades
  • Participação em um projeto com grande projeção e crescimento
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo
  • Treinamento 100% pago
  • Modalidade 100% remota

Previsão de início : Julho de 2025

Requisitos técnicos

  • Computador: processador Core i5 (7ª geração ou superior), ou equivalente, com no mínimo 8 GB de RAM
  • Armazenamento: mínimo de 256 GB SSD ou 500 GB HDD
  • Internet: velocidade mínima de 25 Mbps (upload e download)
  • Sistema operacional: Windows original
  • Áudio: fones de ouvido com cancelamento de ruído
  • Vídeo: notebook/PC com webcam ou câmera de boa qualidade

title: Recruiter Senior
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações, não deixe de se aplicar. Focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.

Regime : PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral

Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A / B / C / D até grandes multinacionais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida / efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.

Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.

Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável

O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.

Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Product Manager (Open Finance)
description:
Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!

O Product Manager no Asaas desempenha um papel fundamental ao alinhar as necessidades dos clientes com os objetivos estratégicos do negócio e do mercado. Sua principal missão será liderar a squad responsável pelo produto e pelas funcionalidades relacionadas ao Open Finance na plataforma do Asaas. Essa posição oferece um alto nível de impacto e inovação, pois você estará à frente da definição da visão e da implementação das funcionalidades de Open Finance, abrangendo tanto os aspectos regulatórios quanto a integração dessas soluções aos produtos já existentes na plataforma. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com os times de Engenharia, Design e Dados, capacitados para te ajudar nessa missão.

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

  • Identificar oportunidades para impulsionar engajamento e conversão através de melhorias estratégicas nas jornadas do produto
  • Realizar entregas que geram valor: entender profundamente o cliente para entregar a melhor solução possível, considerando ganhos e esforço;
  • Retirar obstáculos e entregar grandes projetos em pequenas partes coerentes e de alto valor;
  • Contribuir para a visão estratégica do produto, traçando objetivos com base nos interesses do negócio, momento do mercado e necessidade dos clientes;
  • Tomar decisões baseadas em dados e fatos concretos, definindo e acompanhando as métricas do produto;
  • Atuar em conjunto com a área de Design, Growth, Engenharia de software e Engenharia de Dados;
  • Assegurar que todas as áreas da empresa sejam consultadas ou informadas quando necessário, sobre alterações no produto e também atuar em conjunto com a equipe de marketing na comunicação com o cliente, gerando engajamento;
  • Ser guiado pelo desenvolvimento constante, saindo da zona de conforto.

Requisitos

  • Vivência no setor de serviços financeiros para empresas;
  • Experiência na função de Product Manager com foco em jornadas de usuário;
  • Vivência e conhecimento aprofundado em Open Finance e regulamentação do PIX;
  • Conhecimento em APIs;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL;
  • Ter familiaridade com metodologias de design centrado no usuário, como Design Thinking, ou conhecimento em UX/UI, para colaborar de forma mais eficaz com designers e potencializar a criação de soluções;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar informações de maneira clara e concisa para diferentes públicos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e métricas fundamentais de produto;
  • Vivencia com gestão de produtos regulados pelo Banco Central.

Diferenciais

  • Ensino superior em contabilidade, administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Cursos de capacitação na área (Tera, PM3, entre outros);
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de produtos digitais;
  • Atuação em Fintech;
  • Atuação direta com o Open Finance;
  • Carga horária de 8h por dia (segunda a sexta-feira - não compensamos os sábados);
  • Contratação CLT.

NÓS QUEREMOS MUDAR O MUNDO E COMEÇAMOS POR AQUI! VOCÊ VEM COM A GENTE?

Somos uma super Fintech, Instituição de Pagamento credenciada pelo Banco Central do Brasil e temos como propósito maximizar a produtividade das empresas através da tecnologia. Oferecemos uma solução completa para gestão de cobranças, pagamentos, antecipações de recebíveis e atendemos mais de 200 mil clientes divididos entre profissionais autônomos, microempreendedores individuais (MEI) e grandes empresas.

Nosso sonho começou em 2010, em Joinville/SC e acreditamos que o céu não é o limite para o nosso crescimento. Não é à toa que atualmente nosso time está em vários cantos do Brasil! Mais de 800 pessoas sonham junto com o Asaas, de forma colaborativa, inovadora, eficiente, com autonomia e liberdade para voar alto.

Voos altos exigem recursos para viver e trabalhar melhor, além de liberdade para administrá-los da melhor forma. Por isso, acolhemos e cuidamos do nosso time oferecendo benefícios que apoiam seu crescimento pessoal e profissional:

Para saúde e bem-estar: temos assistência médica e odontológica sem coparticipação, seguro de vida, auxílio para compra de medicamentos e para realizar atividades físicas. Além disso, temos parceira para cuidar da saúde financeira do time e para a saúde física e mental.

Para alimentação e família: nosso benefício alimentação é flexível, por meio de um cartão de crédito, bandeira Visa. O saldo pode ser usado como cada um desejar. Na sede, temos free food e, para as famílias, oferecemos auxílio creche, programa de apoio parental e licença maternidade e paternidade estendida.

Para educação e crescimento: além de um ambiente de desafios e muito desenvolvimento, temos uma plataforma de treinamentos e disponibilizamos auxílio educação que subsidia 70% de mensalidades de graduações e idiomas, bem como a compra de cursos e livros, para que nosso time nunca pare de aprender.

Para o trabalho remoto de qualidade: oferecemos auxílio Home Office, equipamentos de trabalho, auxílio mobília e temos parceria com a WOBA, para os nossos colaboradores usarem coworkings em todo o Brasil quando desejarem.

Extras, porque o Dream Team merece: temos Day Off no mês do aniversário, auxílio Happy Hour, bonificação por indicação de novos colaboradores, bonificação baseada em metas anuais, plano de Stock Option e um ambiente leve.

description:
Overview

Role : Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics : We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry / salon space.

Contract : Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours : Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate : $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start : Immediately

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You\'ll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it\'s not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.
